purpose: Decision-print shapes per seat + G4–G7 prove/close/reject for Helm to compile into docs/MACHINE_UPGRADE_BUNDLE.md. Process only. staff_proposed Upgrade chips until Kenneth locks via Master.

decision_print_rule.kenneth_locked: Staff/Master handoff + Machine log (Kenneth 2026-09-07): print only on decision change with why. No wait spam. No invent.
decision_print_rule.row_vs_tape: Plan row always holds last_decision + last_why. Machine log tape only logs LOGGABLE decision changes (see machine/log.py). wait stays on the row, not the tape.

shapes_per_seat.print_when: first entry into met band (decision change)
shapes_per_seat.shape: met | {name} | price? | why: met — low entered band (or equivalent Chart why)

shapes_per_seat.owns: buy when print tags hung AD buy layer, or board panic; wait otherwise
shapes_per_seat.tape_action: paper-buy (only after Size fills) or sit-out (at AD Path sit). wait never on tape.
shapes_per_seat.print_when: Path sit at AD (sit-out + Path why). Path buy appears on tape only as paper-buy/add-panic after Size fill, why usually Path tag/panic sentence.
shapes_per_seat.shape_buy: paper-buy | {name} | price | size_pct? | why: Path — tags hung AD buy layer / board panic (Path why)
shapes_per_seat.shape_sit: sit-out | {name} | price | why: Path sit reason (at AD only on tape)
shapes_per_seat.shape_wait: row only: wait | why clear (not tagged / not hung). No Machine log line.

shapes_per_seat.owns: which layers fill; real-volume gate; grind wait; AD-side scale; panic shares
shapes_per_seat.tape_action: paper-buy on fill; sit-out when Path bought and Size waits/cancels at AD (or board-grind note)
shapes_per_seat.print_when: fill; or Path-buy then Size wait/cancel with clear Size why at AD
shapes_per_seat.shape_fill: paper-buy | {name} | price | size_pct | why: Path why (fill owned by Size)
shapes_per_seat.shape_wait: sit-out | {name} | price | why: Size grind wait / Size volume / Path buy — no AD buy layer reached (Size why). Board grind may force second sit-out: board-wide grind — Size wait for volume
shapes_per_seat.shape_miss_row: row: sit-out/wait | why: Path buy but no Size layer at or through current price (S5). Tape mute when not at AD is intentional (sit-out-at-AD rule).
shapes_per_seat.does_not_own: Path tag / panic buy gate; met band

shapes_per_seat.owns: break of AD → add panic half (not flatten)
shapes_per_seat.print_when: met already true; current price under B; panic layers fill
shapes_per_seat.shape: add-panic | {name} | price | size_pct? | why: Fail — current price broke AD; add panic half
shapes_per_seat.must_not: Path sit must not block Fail add-panic under a met AD

shapes_per_seat.owns: sell layers; into named base; leftover; sideways-too-long when Reed number exists
shapes_per_seat.print_when: sell fill or exit live-read adapt decision change
shapes_per_seat.shape_sell: paper-sell | {name} | price | why: layer why or into big base / unmet base (no invent)
shapes_per_seat.shape_adapt: exit-live | {name} | price | why: joined adapt reasons
shapes_per_seat.conflict_rule: Named unmet base clips bounce map high. Machine sells into the named base and does not wait for bounce length past it. Bounce map is not a second exit owner.

shapes_per_seat.print_when: action + why change per name; skip wait and duplicate same key
shapes_per_seat.shape: {ts, manila, action, name, price, size_pct, why}
shapes_per_seat.banned: wait spam; invent fills; invent sell targets
